images.caption: Four Commonwealth War Graves in the General cemetery of Putten in Gelderland, the Netherlands. The three headstones are for members of 418 Squadron RCAF. Beyond them is the grave of a sapper of the Royal Engineers, which is marked by a steel helmet instead of a headstone.
